description:
Get Sequence Ontology term definition.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table so — one record = one Sequence Ontology term.
Key: id.
Arguments: so_id accepts so term (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Sequence Ontology terms of OT 25.09 (existence only).

so_id.description: Accepts so_term; resolved to one so_term (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
